items.title: Define Koala-owned lifecycle artifact policy
items.context: Add a central policy for story-scoped Koala-generated lifecycle artifacts and command provenance, so scope logic can distinguish metadata ledger files from product source changes.
items.userSees: Scope output includes "Koala lifecycle artifact (command-generated metadata)" for delivery-check.json and summary.json, while arbitrary files still show "OUT_OF_SCOPE".

happy.desc: A Koala command generated lifecycle artifact is classified as Koala-owned metadata with provenance.

edge.desc: The allowed lifecycle artifact list is narrow and story-scoped; unrelated files are not classified as lifecycle metadata.

adversarial.desc: A product source file or arbitrary unknown JSON still fails scope when unacknowledged.

items.title: Stop TEST-phase delivery and summary artifacts from blocking DONE
items.context: delivery_check_set and summary_set should internally record a restricted metadata acknowledgement for the files they create, without enabling broad TEST-phase scope expansion.
items.userSees: After delivery_check_set and summary_set in TEST, story_advance --phase=DONE no longer fails only because delivery-check.json or summary.json are out of scope.

happy.desc: A TEST story can generate delivery-check.json and summary.json and then pass DONE without rollback repair.

edge.desc: TEST phase still rejects ordinary scope_contract_acknowledge or unrelated file expansion.

adversarial.desc: Manually adding an unrelated file in TEST still blocks DONE even if delivery and summary are allowed.

items.title: Make convergence_check ignore derived builds and survive symlink loops
items.context: convergence_check must not crash on SwiftPM .build/checkouts symlink loops such as GRDB CustomSQLite, and should ignore common derived runtime folders by default.
items.userSees: koala convergence_check returns a normal pass/fail report instead of ELOOP when .build exists.

happy.desc: convergence_check skips .build and derived runtime directories during scanning.

edge.desc: A fixture symlink loop does not crash convergence_check.

adversarial.desc: Ignoring derived directories does not hide real docs/story files from convergence checks.

items.title: Make session_brief next-step respect blocking scope failures
items.context: When scope gate is failing, session_brief should not tell the agent to advance DONE before resolving the blocking scope condition.
items.userSees: session_brief clearly says scope gate is blocking and names the repair path before recommending DONE.

happy.desc: When scope gate fails, next-step prioritizes scope repair and does not recommend DONE.

edge.desc: When only delivery or summary is missing, session_brief still recommends the correct reviewer or summary command.

adversarial.desc: When all gates pass, session_brief may recommend DONE only after no blocking scope failure remains.

items.title: Prove the full Koala workflow regression path
items.context: Add tests and transcript evidence proving the combined fixes prevent B-1261-style lifecycle self-lock while preserving out-of-scope protection.
items.userSees: A new story can go through REVIEW, TEST, delivery-check, summary, DONE, koala check, and convergence_check without manual rollback solely for Koala lifecycle metadata.

happy.desc: Regression tests cover lifecycle artifact metadata acknowledgement, convergence symlink handling, and session_brief blocking next-step output.

edge.desc: koala check and convergence_check pass on the final repository state.

adversarial.desc: The final evidence explicitly states this does not weaken product source scope enforcement.
